milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The purple banner is at spawn-relative (-6, 1, -6) in the back-left corner of the stone brick building. The player must navigate through the oak plank doorway and get close enough to visually identify the banner. max_distance=5 ensures the player has entered the left room section (past the partition at x=-3), and facing_tolerance=60 confirms the player is looking toward the banner, modeling 'player can see the target'.
